extraction.name: C-E VAL
extraction.description: C-E VAL comprises multiple-choice questions across four difficulty levels: middle school, high school, college, and professional. The questions span 52 diverse disciplines, ranging from humanities to science and engineering.
extraction.creator: Yuzhen Huang, Yuzhuo Bai, Zhihao Zhu, Junlei Zhang, Jinghan Zhang, Tangjun Su, Junteng Liu, Chuancheng Lv, Yikai Zhang, Jiayi Lei, Yao Fu, Maosong Sun, Junxian He
extraction.publisher: 37th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2023)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected from mock exams freely available on the internet, past exam questions from top Chinese universities shared by students, and mock questions for the national graduate entrance exam from the Weipu website.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Mock exams freely available on the internet, past exam questions from top universities in China, and mock questions for the national graduate entrance exam from the Weipu website.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Complex mathematical notations were manually converted into standard LATEX formats. Questions were processed to include exactly four choices by eliminating questions with fewer than four options and randomly dropping incorrect choices for questions with more than four options.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Questions underwent a standard data preprocessing pipeline including deduplication and cleaning, followed by several rounds of human validation by the authors to ensure LATEX notations complied without syntax errors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automatic generation combined with human annotation was used to produce explanation data for the development split. GPT-4 was prompted to generate step-by-step explanations for ground-truth answers, which were then manually revised by the authors.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is anticipated to help analyze strengths and shortcomings of foundation models and foster their development for Chinese users.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark is not perfect for comprehensive LLM evaluation as it does not cover abilities like reasoning over and calling APIs, or aspects beyond accuracy such as safety, bias, and robustness.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Testing and evaluating advanced knowledge and reasoning abilities of foundation models in a Chinese context, in both answer-only and chain-of-thought settings.

name.evidence: We present C-E VAL , the first comprehensive Chinese evaluation suite designed to assess advanced knowledge and reasoning abilities of foundation models in a Chinese context .

description.evidence: C-E VAL comprises multiple-choice questions across four difficulty levels: middle school, high school, college, and professional. The questions span 52 diverse disciplines, ranging from humanities to science and engineering.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: The collected data come in various formats, primarily as PDF or Microsoft Word documents and a minor fraction as web pages. PDF documents are initially processed into text.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: For subjects with complex mathematical notations such as many subjects in the STEM category, we manually convert them into standard L ATEX formats... All the questions inC-E VAL are processed to include exactly four choices. Most of the original questions were accompanied by four choices already, and we eliminate questions with fewer than four options and randomly drop incorrect choices for questions with more than four options.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: All questions also go through the standard data preprocessing pipeline, such as deduplication and cleaning. Following this, the questions undergo several rounds of human validation by the authors, and all the L ATEX notations are ensured to be complied without syntax errors.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: Specifically, we first prompt GPT-4 to generate step-by-step explanation to explain the ground-truth answer, then we manually revise the generated explanations to obtain the final explanations.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: Specifically, we first prompt GPT-4 to generate step-by-step explanation to explain the ground-truth answer

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: We anticipate C-E VAL will help analyze important strengths and shortcomings of foundation models, and foster their development and growth for Chinese users.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: C-E VAL, along with all the English-language benchmarks, is far from perfect for LLM evaluation. There are many other abilities such as reasoning over and calling APIs, as well as multiple aspects that extend beyond accuracy, including safety, bias, and robustness.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We present C-E VAL , the first comprehensive Chinese evaluation suite designed to assess advanced knowledge and reasoning abilities of foundation models in a Chinese context ... We conduct experiments to evaluate the most advanced LLMs on C-E VAL in both answer-only and chain-of-thought settings.
